campaign.title: First month (25 Sep to 21 Oct 2026): supplier recruitment and how QuotesDone works
campaign.theme: Supplier recruitment (the first 1,000 suppliers join free, permanently) and how QuotesDone works; 12 founder-made videos on LinkedIn, Facebook, X, YouTube, Instagram and TikTok; English only; organic only

posts.caption_en:
If your business is licensed in the UAE, there is a place for it on QuotesDone.

Products, services, manufacturing, fit-out, logistics, technology and more. Suppliers are invited only to requests that match the trades and services they confirm on their verified profile, from customers anywhere in the UAE. Registration is open to every trade except food and beverage, for now. The first 1,000 suppliers to register pay no subscription, permanently.

Register your business: https://quotesdone.ae/supplier?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=2026_10_supplier_recruitment
posts.alt_text: Animated video in teal and white. Headlines: "Your business. Your opportunity." "Across UAE sectors. Beyond the usual trades." "Show what you do. Meet requests that fit." "More chances to be considered." Tiles show technology, creative, manufacturing, logistics, fit-out, products, business services and specialist trades. Small print: food and beverage excluded, verification applies, request volume and sales are not guaranteed. End card: "Join early. Subscription-free forever." for the first 1,000 suppliers, Register your business, quotesdone.com/supplier.
posts.rationale: Sprout Social: LinkedIn strongest Tue-Thu late morning to afternoon (local time); UAE agency guides agree on 10:00-16:00. 11:30 Dubai lands before lunch in the working day.

posts.caption_en:
No featured suppliers. No paid ranking.

On QuotesDone every quotation you submit is shown to the customer, and the strongest three are compared on price, completeness and delivery, not on what a supplier pays. Membership does not buy a better position, and neither does registering early. The first 1,000 suppliers to register pay no subscription, permanently.

posts.caption_en:
A name is easy. A check matters.

Before a supplier is matched to any request, QuotesDone checks the business behind the name: a current trade licence, the company profile, a verified mobile and email, and signed supplier terms. Expired licences stay out of matching. It is an important first step, not a guarantee of workmanship. The first 1,000 suppliers to register pay no subscription, permanently.

Register your business: https://quotesdone.ae/supplier?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=2026_10_supplier_recruitment
posts.alt_text: Animated video on a light background. Headlines: "A name is easy. A check matters." "Start with the licence. Number. Issuing authority. Expiry." "Current documents. A stronger start. Expired licences stay out of matching." "Checked before you're connected. An important first step. Not a quality guarantee." A wheel links business name, mobile, email, trade licence, company profile and signed terms. End card: "Confidence starts with the checks." Meet QuotesDone, quotesdone.com. Licence checks do not certify workmanship.

posts.caption_en:
You are judged on the work, not on who you know.

Customers on QuotesDone share the brief, not their identity. As a supplier you see the scope and the quantities with personal details removed, and you quote on the job itself. The customer's name reaches you when they choose you. The first 1,000 suppliers to register pay no subscription, permanently.
